data.current_summary: Import from a public link, or open a direct upload
data.current_description:
Two mutually exclusive shapes:
- `audioUrl`: import a YouTube video, a podcast (RSS feed or Apple Podcasts page)
  or a direct audio/video file URL. Spotify is not supported (DRM).
- `filename` + `contentType`: open a direct upload. The response carries a

Transcription is asynchronous: poll `GET /v1/notes/{id}` until `status` is "ready".
data.summary_suggestion: Create a note from URL or initiate direct upload
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new note by either importing from a public URL or initiating a direct file upload. For URL imports, supports YouTube videos, podcasts (RSS feeds or Apple Podcasts pages), and direct audio/video file URLs (Spotify not supported due to DRM). For direct uploads, provide filename and contentType; the response includes a presigned upload.url where you must PUT the file bytes, then call POST /v1/notes/{id}/finalize to start processing. Transcription is asynchronous; poll GET /v1/notes/{id} until status is "ready". Returns 202 with note ID and upload details.
